What do I need to know first?

Liam Wilson
Start with the goal: book an appointment and describe a symptom.

You
Can you give me an example?

Isabella Martinez
Sure. In this situation, we can say “appointment” and ask about “symptom”.

You
What if the other person does not understand?

Liam Wilson
Ask for clarification and calmly rephrase.
Pide una aclaración y reformula con calma.

So I can confirm the details before answering.

Exactly. You can also use “pain” to keep the conversation going.
Exacto. También puedes usar “pain” para mantener la conversación.
You
Thanks, I’ll try it now.
Gracias, lo intentaré ahora.
Liam Wilson
Great. If the situation changes, adjust your tone.
Muy bien. Si cambia la situación, adapta el tono.
